role: SKEPTIC / adversarial re-run of the STATIC-CMOS-STRIPPING path
doctrine: Re-run, do not read. Every number below is to be produced by decks and extractors written in this directory. No number is to be copied from qal/strip/ or any other committed study; where I quote a primary or committed value it is ONLY as a target to be reproduced or refuted, and it is labelled as such.

S0_TOOLING_CHALLENGE_TO_THE_BRIEF_ITSELF.claim_in_brief: sg13_lv via qal/sg13lv_compat.sp ZEROES ad/as/pd/ps -- device numbers are LOWER bounds and junction leakage is ABSENT
S0_TOOLING_CHALLENGE_TO_THE_BRIEF_ITSELF.my_reading_of_the_source_BEFORE_measurin: qal/sg13lv_compat.sp declares ad/as/pd/ps as SUBCKT parameters with default 0 but its body is 'M1 d g s b sg13g2_nmos W={w} L={l}' -- ad/as/pd/ps are NEVER referenced, so they are accepted and DISCARDED. The PSP103 instance therefore runs at the MODEL's own defaults, which PSP103_module.include line 146-149 gives as ABSOURCE=ABDRAIN=1.0e-12 m^2 and LSSOURCE=LGSOURCE=1.0e-6 m. swjuncap=3 in sg13g2_psp103_tt.lib, i.e. JUNCAP200 is ENABLED.
S0_TOOLING_CHALLENGE_TO_THE_BRIEF_ITSELF.S1_PREDICTION: Junction leakage is NOT absent. It is present at a DEFAULT junction geometry of 1.0 um^2 bottom area and 1.0 um edge length, which is LARGER than any realistic contacted-diffusion geometry for a 0.74-1.12 um wide device. Therefore the leakage numbers are NOT lower bounds on account of the junction term; if anything that term is OVER-represented.
S0_TOOLING_CHALLENGE_TO_THE_BRIEF_ITSELF.how_I_will_test_it: Instantiate the raw sg13g2_nmos/sg13g2_pmos model directly on an M-card with AD/AS/PD/PS set explicitly, in three arms in ONE deck: (i) DEFAULT (= what the shim delivers), (ii) ZERO (AD=AS=PD=PS=0, what the brief believes it has), (iii) REALISTIC (AD=AS=0.2516e-12 m^2, PD=PS=2.16e-6 m, a contacted 0.34 um diffusion on the campaign-standard widths). Falsifiable: if arm (i) equals arm (ii) then the shim really does zero the junction and my S1 is wrong.
S0_TOOLING_CHALLENGE_TO_THE_BRIEF_ITSELF.S1_PREREG_FALSIFIER: If I(default) == I(zero) to within the measurement floor, S1 is REFUTED and the brief's framing stands.

A_LEAKAGE_BUDGET.rail_V: the delivered QAL rail measured in this run's own bank deck; ALSO reported at a stated fixed 0.6077 V so the number is comparable
A_LEAKAGE_BUDGET.S2_PREDICTION: Fraction of node charge lost per 200 ps beat < 0.01 % in EVERY junction arm including the realistic one, i.e. the user's premise survives. I further predict the realistic arm is HIGHER than the zero arm but that the difference does not change the order of magnitude of the verdict.
A_LEAKAGE_BUDGET.S2_PREREG_FALSIFIER: If the realistic-junction arm loses > 1 % of node charge per 200 ps beat, the premise is materially weakened and I must say so.
A_LEAKAGE_BUDGET.S3_null_control: A 2 fF capacitor with NOTHING attached, in the same deck, same solver options. Must droop < 1 uV over the measurement window or the droop numbers are solver drift and unquotable.
A_LEAKAGE_BUDGET.S4_resistor_calibration: A known 1e12 ohm resistor from the node to ground, in the same deck. Must read I = V/R within 1 %; establishes the current floor of this harness.
A_LEAKAGE_BUDGET.S5_keeper_arm: Same node with a conventional staticiser fitted, to price the keeper over one beat.
A_LEAKAGE_BUDGET.solver_floor_discipline: RELTOL on the rail sets a voltage resolution floor. The hold window MUST be long enough that the droop is >= 20x that floor, and I will state the floor next to the number. A droop comparable to RELTOL*rail is NOISE and will be reported as 'below floor', not as a value.

B_O21AI_ANCHOR_AND_STRIPPED.static_control: o21ai-equivalent hand-built from discrete campaign-standard devices (nMOS 0.74u, pMOS 1.12u, l=0.13u): Y = !(A1|A2)&B1 ... specifically the sg13g2 o21ai function Y = !((A1|A2)&B1). pMOS network: series pair (A1,A2 in parallel-source config) per the dual. Truth table VERIFIED exhaustively against the function before any timing number is quoted.
B_O21AI_ANCHOR_AND_STRIPPED.stripped_cell: 2 grounded nMOS trees (f and f_bar, factored series-parallel) + 2 cross-coupled pMOS with SOURCE AND BULK on the rail. NO keeper. NO precharge device. Device count asserted from the netlist by counting M-cards, not from intent.
input_conventions_BOTH_REQUIRED: dV convention (inputs swing to the full drive amplitude dV, the committed bank convention)
RAIL-REFERENCED (inputs swing only to the delivered rail, the real chain condition)
B_O21AI_ANCHOR_AND_STRIPPED.S6_PREDICTION: Static o21ai_hb NEVER reaches 90 % of the instantaneous rail within a 500 ps tail (I expect s_end near 83 %, t_valid80 near 515 ps). Stripped at wxc=1.12 DOES settle under the dV convention. Stripped FAILS under rail-referenced inputs. I predict the primary's headline 'settles where static cannot' is TRUE ONLY under the dV convention and therefore is NOT a chain-relevant result.
B_O21AI_ANCHOR_AND_STRIPPED.S7_PREDICTION: When the cross-coupled pair actually resolves, |Vgs|/rail of the conducting pull-up >= 0.94 at the conduction instant and >= 0.96 later, with Vbs EXACTLY 0.000 V because source and bulk are the same net. When the pair does NOT resolve, |Vgs|/rail falls to <= 0.80, i.e. no better than the static series device -- the mechanism advantage is CONTINGENT.
B_O21AI_ANCHOR_AND_STRIPPED.conduction_instant_definition: max of d(V_node - V_rail)/dt, NOT max dV/dt (which lands on the rail ramp and measures nothing). Reported ALSO at the 50 % crossing, at the freeze and at the end so no single definition carries the claim.
B_O21AI_ANCHOR_AND_STRIPPED.S8_THE_NMOS_WALL: I predict the binding threshold is the nMOS, not the pMOS: Vtn > |Vtp| in this PDK. I will MEASURE both in this directory (Id = 100 nA * W/L at |Vds| = 0.1 V) rather than inherit them. If Vtn > |Vtp| then an nMOS-only tree has LESS headroom than the pMOS network it replaced and the |Vtp| wall is not removed, only relocated onto a worse device.

C_DEVICE_COUNT_AUDIT.S9_PREDICTION: Counting only the cell, stripped - static = 2 - (inversion overhead) for a single-stage series-parallel gate. I predict the primary's table is ARITHMETICALLY right and yet UNDER-CHARGED, because dual-rail needs BOTH input polarities and a single-rail predecessor does not supply them. If the complement must be generated, each dual-rail input costs an extra inverter (2 devices) at the boundary, which for a 3-input cell is +6 devices and reverses every tie and the single mux2 win.
C_DEVICE_COUNT_AUDIT.audit_rule: Count M-cards in the actual netlist. Charge the complement explicitly under two accounting regimes: (i) FULLY DUAL-RAIL FABRIC (complement free from the predecessor, the primary's implicit assumption), (ii) SINGLE-RAIL BOUNDARY (complement must be generated). Report both.
C_DEVICE_COUNT_AUDIT.also_to_charge: the cross-coupled pair's own drive, wire count (2 nets per signal), and what is genuinely REMOVED (keeper, static holding path, precharge device) -- verified absent in the netlist by grep, not asserted.

D_CHAIN.topology: tank-fed, per-bank local tank -> own inductor -> series R -> transfer gate -> that bank's rail, 6 banks, cells fed ONLY by the predecessor bank's output nets (no flop/latch/buffer/level-shifter). Peer-fed NOT tested (pre-registered exclusion, it fails for everything).
D_CHAIN.S10_PREDICTION: Stripped chain separation goes NEGATIVE at depth >= 2 (should-be-HIGH nodes sitting BELOW should-be-LOW nodes), because the rail-referenced input levels cannot break the cross-coupled pair. Static control keeps POSITIVE separation to depth 6 but with per-gate values wrong at most depths.
D_CHAIN.pattern_guard: For every node claimed correct, report the minimum gate drive on the devices that are supposed to be pulling it, against the MEASURED Vtn. A node that is merely UNDISTURBED (its pull device off) must NOT be scored as correct. 4/8 correct on a dual-rail bank is the by-construction score of an UNRESOLVED pair and will be called out as such, not reported as half-working.

checks: grep every deck for ideal voltage sources and classify each as (legitimate: head stimulus / instrument ammeter / tank precharge) or (illegitimate: supplying the thing being measured)
confirm the cross-coupled pair's own drive current is inside the metered boundary, not supplied by a source outside it
confirm metering is 1F-integrator or INTEG-I(Vsrc)+PARAM only, t0-referenced, and that no '.measure INTEGRAL V(<B-source>)' appears anywhere
confirm no ideal source holds a rail that is claimed to be tank-supplied
confirm the freeze/ZCS instant has |I(L)| below 1 uA so no energy is in flight at the read

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_BINDING.A1_anchor: static o21ai_hb s_end within +/-3 pp of the committed 82.99 % and t_valid80 within +/-10 % of the committed 515.1 ps, ELSE my harness is not the campaign harness and no comparison of mine is admissible.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_BINDING.A2_settle: all checked nodes simultaneously within 10 % of the INSTANTANEOUS rail and staying so to the end of the window. t_valid90 = first such time. A node still moving at the end has NOT settled.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_BINDING.A3_instrument: |I(L)| at the freeze instant < 1 uA on every reported row.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_BINDING.A4_leak_floor: null control < 1 uV over window AND resistor calibration within 1 %.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_BINDING.A5_droop: worst-node droop over the beat compared against a receiver threshold window MEASURED IN THIS RUN at a true steady state, not inherited and not read at a settling-limited time.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_BINDING.A6_truth_tables: every logic tree verified exhaustively against its function over all input vectors before any timing number from that cell is quoted.

WHAT_WOULD_MAKE_ME_SAY_THE_STRIPPING_IDE: the stripped o21ai does not settle at matched sizing under ANY input convention
the stripped chain carries no information at depth >= 2 AND the static control does
the device-count win disappears once the complement is charged
the leakage premise fails under a realistic junction estimate
the pull-up Vgs is not ~-rail even when the pair resolves
WHAT_WOULD_MAKE_ME_SAY_IT_SUCCEEDS: stripped settles at rail-referenced inputs where static cannot, AND propagates with positive separation to depth 6

SIM_DISCIPLINE_COMMITMENTS.concurrency: <= 3 concurrent heavy Xyce jobs. The box is shared; load at start was 7.15/16 with other workflows' jobs already running. I will poll load before each launch batch.
SIM_DISCIPLINE_COMMITMENTS.models: sg13_lv via qal/sg13lv_compat.sp for cell work; RAW sg13g2_nmos/pmos M-cards ONLY in the junction-geometry arms where the whole point is to set AD/AS/PD/PS, and that substitution is declared per row.
SIM_DISCIPLINE_COMMITMENTS.reserved: vt/gmin NOT touched. Corners only via instance-level DTA if needed (.OPTIONS DEVICE TEMP is inert here).
SIM_DISCIPLINE_COMMITMENTS.metering: 1F integrator or INTEG-I(Vsrc)+PARAM only; every read t0-referenced; no '.measure INTEGRAL V(<B-source>)'
SIM_DISCIPLINE_COMMITMENTS.extraction: all speed/settle numbers read off the .prn by this directory's own extractor, no .measure in the speed path
SIM_DISCIPLINE_COMMITMENTS.unique_va_module_names: not applicable -- no new .va authored in this run

DECLARED_MODEL_BIAS_AND_WHICH_WAY_EACH_C.junction_geometry_at_PSP103_default: AB=1e-12 m^2 is LARGER than realistic for these widths -> OVERSTATES junction leakage -> measured leakage is an UPPER bound on that term, not a lower bound
DECLARED_MODEL_BIAS_AND_WHICH_WAY_EACH_C.gmin: any gmin component ADDS to measured leakage -> upper bound
DECLARED_MODEL_BIAS_AND_WHICH_WAY_EACH_C.absent_drain_junction_capacitance_if_AD_: would make the node LIGHTER than reality -> OVERSTATES the lost charge fraction; at PSP103 default AB the node is if anything HEAVIER than realistic -> understates the fraction. Direction therefore depends on the arm and I will state it per arm.
DECLARED_MODEL_BIAS_AND_WHICH_WAY_EACH_C.tt_only: no corner spread claimed; every number is typical-typical
DECLARED_MODEL_BIAS_AND_WHICH_WAY_EACH_C.hand_built_o21ai_vs_PDK_subckt: hand-built at campaign-standard widths uses the STRONGER device than the PDK cell -> generous to the static control -> any stripped win over it is conservative
